summary: Stored the Grenada CBI Unit fees page archived 29 June 2015 (Wayback id_ capture) and extracted its fee schedule; the existing government-fee rule t-d11adc5896 quoted this page but cited a different stored page.

sources.title: Grenada Citizenship by Investment Unit website: Fees (archived 29 June 2015)
sources.publisher: Government of Grenada (Citizenship by Investment Unit)
sources.covers: 2015 fee schedule for the NTF contribution and real estate options: application, processing, due diligence and (real estate) government fees.
sources.notes: Archived web page; published_date is the capture date.

program_terms.applies_to: same amount in every family-size column (single applicant to main applicant + more than 3 dependants), NTF contribution and real estate options
program_terms.location: Fees page, table "NTF Contribution" and table "Real Estate Option" (same row in both)
program_terms.notes: As displayed on 29 June 2015 (archived copy); the page doesn't give a start date. The page prints the amount without a unit (not stated whether per application or per person); it is the same in every family-size column.

program_terms.notes: As displayed on 29 June 2015 (archived copy); the page doesn't give a start date. The NTF table prints the same amounts, worded 'per dependent'.

ledger.contains: Fee tables for the two investment options (NTF contribution; real estate) by family size: application fee, processing fee, due diligence fee, and the real estate government fee (US$50,000 for 1-4 people, US$25,000 per additional dependant). No NTF contribution amount on this page.
